tagline: HOL Guard coverage for Kelados CLI commands that synthesize audio or start a local TTS server.
summary: Reviews kelados speak, which writes a WAV file to disk, and kelados serve, which starts a local HTTP server exposing TTS synthesis endpoints. The read-only kelados voices subcommand is not matched.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the speak and serve subcommands and the surrounding Guard policy.
The kelados voices subcommand is not matched; it queries available voice IDs and Guard's default handling applies to it.
Version-pinned npx/bunx invocations (e.g. npx kelados@1.0.2 speak) are covered for versions 1.0.0–1.0.2; later releases require a source update.
